# SpikeDecoder

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neural network architecture that adapts the transformer decoder block to use spike-based computations for autoregressive token generation. Enables GPT-style language models to run on neuromorphic hardware, bridging the gap between deep learning and event-driven computing.
